source_text: Design a small storage box with a hinged lid. The lid should stay closed until the user releases it with a thumb. The box should be safe to use, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture.
product_intent: A small, desktop-sized storage box with a hinged lid that remains closed until manually released by a user's thumb, designed for safe use, easy assembly, and practical manufacturing through additive processes.
user_intent_summary: Design a small, desktop-sized storage box with a hinged lid that stays closed until released by the user's thumb, using additive manufacturing, and ensuring it is safe, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture.

clauses.text: Design a small storage box with a hinged lid
The lid should stay closed until the user releases it with a thumb
The box should be safe to use

requirements.statement: The storage box must have a hinged lid that remains closed until manually released by a user's thumb

verification.observable: Lid remains closed until thumb is applied to release mechanism
verification.condition: User applies thumb pressure to lid release mechanism

requirements.statement: The storage box must be safe to use

verification.observable: Absence of sharp edges, toxic materials, or hazardous components

requirements.statement: The storage box must be easy to assemble

verification.observable: Assembly process can be completed within specified time frame without tools

requirements.statement: The storage box must be practical to manufacture

verification.observable: Manufacturing process can be completed using standard equipment and materials

requirements.statement: The storage box must be desktop-sized

verification.observable: Dimensions of product meet specified desktop size requirements

requirements.statement: The storage box must operate manually only

verification.observable: Product operates without electronic or mechanical power source

requirements.statement: The storage box must be designed for additive manufacturing

verification.observable: Product design compatible with additive manufacturing processes
verification.condition: Design reviewed for additive manufacturing compatibility

operating_scenarios.name: Normal Operation
operating_scenarios.description: User places items in storage box and closes lid manually, then opens by applying thumb pressure to release mechanism

operating_scenarios.name: Manufacturing Process
operating_scenarios.description: Product is manufactured using additive manufacturing processes with specified safety and assembly requirements met

operating_scenarios.name: Desktop Use Environment
operating_scenarios.description: Product is used on desktop surfaces with typical user interaction requiring manual operation and safe handling
